These replies exercise the eight-section reformulation, decision, adoption and persistence protocol; they are not the realistic Flood classification reference, a completeness judgment about the source, or live-model quality evidence.

scopeOrigin.note: Preserves the eight independent root questions and the BP/IP child and product prompt scopes used by the bounded reformulation fixture before the Flood semantic-reference expansion.

notes: The requirement text and its source evidence are supplied by ReformulationScenarioCorpus from the Flood scenario and remain unchanged. Alternate authored scenarios replace their source exactly as before.

ReformulationScenarioReplies intentionally implements a fixed eight-section BP/IP protocol. This corpus is independent so adding realistic semantic branches to the Flood reference cannot change that protocol graph.

Every offered candidate, including roots and the concrete product IP-1673, has an explicit answer. Zeros express a bounded protocol choice, not an evidence-based rejection of a requirement or catalogue candidate.
The selected roots and descendant budgets remain 100 to reproduce the existing protocol inputs. All other root scores are zero, so they do not expand into unsupported sections.
This protocol corpus must not be used as evidence for classification quality, domain completeness, independent expert agreement, or the usefulness of a Sparx export.
